steps.en: After Confirm, OCMS starts building files for the submitted batch
steps.id: Setelah Confirm, OCMS mulai membuat file untuk batch yang disubmit
steps.why_en: No process starts building court files after confirm.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada proses yang mulai membuat file pengadilan setelah confirm.

steps.en: OCMS generates the case registration file in XML format
steps.id: OCMS membuat file case registration berformat XML
steps.why_en: No court registration XML file is built.
steps.why_id: File XML pendaftaran kasus tidak dibuat.

steps.en: OCMS generates the complaint description in PDF
steps.id: OCMS membuat complaint description dalam PDF
steps.why_en: Complaint description documents are not generated.

steps.en: OCMS generates the charge sheet in PDF
steps.id: OCMS membuat charge sheet dalam PDF

steps.en: OCMS sends (interfaces) the files to State Courts via SFTP
steps.id: OCMS mengirim file ke State Courts lewat SFTP
steps.why_en: No file transfer to the State Courts exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengiriman file ke State Courts.

steps.en: The transfer result is recorded so notices proceed with court application
steps.id: Hasil interface dicatat di batch/notice agar notice diproses untuk court application
steps.why_en: The result of a court transfer is not recorded.
steps.why_id: Hasil pengiriman ke pengadilan tidak dicatat.
